testData: Project "Preview demo" is seeded at startup with tickets whose titles start with [seed]: three merged tickets with completed agent executions (Claude and Codex, spread over three weeks), a relaunched ticket in the done column with an open PR (a failed first execution, then a successful one), a legacy merged ticket without executions or a precise implementation start, a failed ticket, a TODO ticket, and a TODO ticket "[seed] Ticket avec questions de faisabilité" with a completed feasibility analysis and three questions (two with recommended answers "Bleu" and "Grande", one without), usable to test the feasibility answer drafts and the button that fills empty answers with the recommended ones. The statistics page therefore shows durations, costs and weekly deliveries. Agents are simulated (KANBAN_DRY_RUN=1): no real session, pull request or merge happens, and launching a ticket only runs a simulated flow. The application has no login.
